goal: Clear S.S. Anne and obtain HM01

subgoals.goal_text: Travel to Vermilion City and enter the S.S. Anne.
Explore the first floor of the S.S. Anne and move to the second floor.
Navigate through the second floor rooms and reach the third floor.
Find and enter the Captain's room on the third floor.
Speak with the Captain to receive HM01 (Cut).
